parsed.post: Significant improvement found by increasing DEPTH from 4 to 8. val_bpb dropped from 1.1078 to 1.0357. The increased capacity seems to outweigh the slower convergence within the 5-minute budget. Now exploring if increasing the learning rate can further accelerate this deeper model.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.12 to compensate for the slower training speed of the deeper (DEPTH=8) model.
